تستقبلين (form X)
# تَسْتَقْبِلِينَ (tastaqbilīna) /tas.taq.bi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
# تُسْتَقْبَلِينَ (tustaqbalīna) /tus.taq.ba.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْبَلَ (istaqbala)
